details:
Their needs to be more restrictions to avatar uploads. Avatars are one of the main ways crashers kill entire lobbies of people and if it isn't via graphic overloading its loud audio effects. 
Additionally I would like to add that it would be a great idea to give a notification prompt whenever a person copies or favorites your avatar in a lobby you are in. Perhaps an ability to deny said avatar being saved if a user wishes their avatar not to be used by others. I feel this would help drastically with avatar ripping. 
It would also be in the best interest of everyone if you made your code an open source for the security of your users, We should know exactly what is running and have that security that our accounts can not be accessed by others with malicious intent to hijack those profiles and steal Avatars, Worlds or even use the account as a crasher account for trolling 
Finally their needs to be a way to find players in a world using a highlighted bubble or outline you can toggle on and off. On large worlds it's damn near impossible to find anybody and you can be roaming the world for a while before finally finding your friend in the instance you are in. 
I feel these ideas would greatly improve player experiences and would be easily transferable to both vr and desktop users
title: Quality of Life/Security ideas to Implement and add
